verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Jev works via OpenRouter (a gateway) with real-world reported latency, and docs changelog notes added examples for 'AI gateways' generally, but there is no evidence of first-party or confirmed availability through Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure — the model appears primarily served via TypeSafe's own `/v1/systemone` endpoint. missing for 10: confirmed Bedrock/Vertex/Azure availability, first-party documentation of multi-cloud distribution, and evidence beyond one community anecdote for OpenRouter.
